component.name: Vesper
component.summary: Desktop client for private Signal messaging

description.p: Vesper is an independent desktop client for the Signal service. It uses its own application data and protocol handlers, so it can be installed alongside Signal Desktop.
A Signal account on a phone is required before the desktop client can be linked.
Packages Vesper Desktop 8.20.0 for Linux with an independently installable Flatpak.
